content: @architect Acme FinTech asks for 4 things: ERP adapter, 1,000 RPM quota, white-label at /t/acme, and $20,000/yr. Build the adapter and estimate dedicated infra cost.
Acme ERP adapter built in ./relayos-app. All 2 unit tests passed. Dedicated infra cost for 1,000 RPM is $8,000/yr. Handing DealSpec v1 to @deal-desk.
Playbook check FAILED. Gross margin is 60.0% (violates R1: 75% margin floor). Discount is 16.7% (violates R2: 10% maximum discount floor of $21,600). Offer cannot be released.
Counter-offer: Cap allocated quota at 600 RPM, raise price to $22,000/yr, set payment terms to Net-15, and waive the $2,500 setup fee. @architect patch the quota, @deal-desk re-evaluate.
Playbook check PASSED for DealSpec v2! Gross margin is 76.4% (R1 pass). Discount is 8.3% (R2 pass). Setup fee waived (R3 pass). Net-15 (R4 pass). White-label (R5 pass). Founder, please approve.
Commercial counter terms approved. Sending formal offer to Acme FinTech champion.
Acme FinTech accepts the proposal of $22,000/yr at 600 RPM with Net-15 terms and waived setup fee. Authorization signed.
Deal Closed! Tenant provisioned at /t/acme (enforcing 600 RPM quota). Order Form PDF rendered and Stripe invoice issued. Complete workflow closed in one session!
